concept.title: Collision warning when a exiting vehicle

conbody.p: The warning light on the outside rear view mirror will blink and the warning message will appear on the cluster, and an audible warning will sound.

li.p: Collision warning when exiting vehicle will warn under the following circumstances:
Your driving speed: below 3 km/h (2 mph)
The speed of the approaching vehicle from the rear: above 6 km/h (4 mph)
